text: 祥源文旅：因实际控制人俞发祥个人涉嫌信息披露违法违规，中国证监会根据《中华人民共和国证券法》《中华人民共和国行政处罚法》等法律法规，决定对其立案。
text_en: Xiangyuan Culture & Tourism: Because actual controller Yu Faxiang is personally suspected of information disclosure violations, the CSRC, in accordance with laws and regulations such as the Securities Law of the People's Republic of China and the Administrative Penalty Law of the People's Republic of China, decided to open an investigation into him.
